profiles.name: Safe
profiles.description: Read-only review and Windows Settings shortcuts. Makes no automatic system changes.
notes: Windows Update, Microsoft Store, Defender, Firewall, UAC, services, and driver settings are left unchanged.

profiles.name: Balanced
profiles.description: Selects the existing Windows Balanced plan if the user chooses Apply; all advanced plan values remain untouched.
notes: The prior active plan is backed up and can be restored. No reboot is required.

profiles.name: Gaming
profiles.description: On a desktop or a laptop explicitly connected to AC power, offers the already-installed High Performance plan. Otherwise it keeps the current plan.
notes: Higher power draw, fan noise, and heat are possible. No FPS gain is promised.

profiles.name: Competitive
profiles.description: Offers the existing High Performance plan only when compatibility and AC-power checks pass. No Realtime process priority, service disabling, BCD, interrupt-affinity, or driver-registry changes are made.
notes: DPC/ISR latency is not measured by this application; frame-time consistency must be measured inside the game or a trusted benchmark.

profiles.name: Maximum Performance
profiles.description: Offers an already-installed Ultimate Performance plan, or High Performance if Ultimate is absent. Requires a separate thermal/power warning confirmation and AC power on portable systems.
notes: This changes only the active built-in plan. It does not disable thermal protection or force CPU/GPU clocks. Do not use automatically while hot or on battery.

profiles.name: Laptop Battery
profiles.description: For a detected portable device, selects the existing Power Saver plan, falling back to Balanced. No maximum-performance policy is applied.
notes: This profile is intended to favor battery life, not maximum gaming performance.

profiles.name: Custom
profiles.description: No changes are preselected. Choose an individual reversible action in its own page.
notes: DNS, cleanup, and power-plan actions require their own previews and confirmations.
